name: Osage National Golf Club
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from opengolfapi, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Palmer, Tournament. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: safe to publish with the hole-1 Palmer tee fix; hole 3 Palmer flagged uncertain (Tournament set is clean on every hole)

1: Palmer marker is on a lidar pad 19 yds behind OSM back box 793605682, at the parking-lot edge.
3: Palmer marker (lidar pad, 377 yds) sits in the parking lot behind the pond. No OSM box is near the card's 370: the two back boxes, 793642994 and 793642993, are both about 330 yds and fit Tournament (card 335).
